Done — I refreshed the UI with a softer glassmorphism-style look, improved backgrounds/cards/buttons, and modernized spacing/hover states without changing app behavior.

I also split and cleaned up the code by:
- reorganizing some shared UI styling into reusable CSS utility classes
- simplifying the main app shell in `src/App.tsx`
- tidying several components and adding a small shared UI helper file

Notes:
- I kept the app’s functionality the same.
- I wasn’t able to fully validate with `npm run lint` because the environment is missing a usable local TypeScript install, and `npm install` failed on `better-sqlite3` due to the container’s Node/Python setup.
